Vendor string bounds are marked `requestOnly` at generation (`red_team_dataplane.py:241`) and asserted request-only, while frozen bounds are pinned at exactly 173 retained checks (`test_g25_generation.py:194-211`).

(4) Regressions are generated, not hand-picked. `tools/g25_fixtures.py:106-243` traverses every one of the 46 strict vendor response roots, emitting format/enum/bound/presence/all-JSON-type mutations with branch-valid `choices` witnesses and recording unreachable null branches in `skippedBranches` (asserted to have a matching `type:null` case). `crates/scm-sdk/tests/g25_response_compatibility.rs:67-136` hashes `cases.json` against `outcomes.casesSha256` before use, then checks all 15,658 cases in Request mode (both the strict root and the public root) and both response modes against the independent outcome, with value-preservation and a typed roundtrip on every acceptance. `:281-344` proves tolerance at every format-bearing `ZodString` in the whole shipped graph (management/IAM/Gateway included) while still rejecting non-strings and counting retained Request-mode rejections. `:358-382`, `:1021-1054`, `:1056-1067` cover all 55 projections across both modes for unset/conforming/null/wrong-type/nested-extra plus u128 preservation; `red_team_contracts.rs:2478-2515` drives the typed public clients for attack lists and target-profile error logs through caller transport in both response modes with `job-1`/`p-1`/`map-1`, novel enums, both reported timestamp forms and a u128 number; `:1213-1310` and `:1557-1641` keep path/query rejections pre-auth.
